Name: Sheep Girl Penny
Author: YukoValis
Description:
After a lot of debate, I went with the obvious.  The last of the 6 main girls transformation is complete!  I give you a new sheep girl for your farm.
This one was a bit different than the others as I struggled with the concept on how to actually use a girl to produce the product.
The way I envision it is attaching a leather like saddle to her back and have her grow the wool.  Much like a chia pet, but like a dozen times more interesting.

The only testing I've done is watch her crawl around for a few minutes, but I doubt there would be anything seriously wrong.  I tried to make it more obvious which stage of sheep she will be.  "baby" has small very white wool.  sheared is just smaller wool, and full grown is a mound.

Content Patcher version of course available.

Also if you are super late to the party and found this mod first somehow, I have others.
